_README: PARTIAL, source-honest FF150 baseline (Mittel-2, 2026-07-02). A full baseline needs a live stock Firefox 150 capture (see README). Until then, every runtime-dependent field is the sentinel "__CAPTURE_PENDING__", which harness.diff_probes() SKIPS — so this file never fabricates a value and never emits a false regression. Asserted concretely are only fields that are hard, verifiable facts and must match Camoufox: navigator.webdriver=false, navigator.cookieEnabled=true, navigator.pdfViewerEnabled=true, webgl.version="WebGL 1.0", webgl.shadingLanguageVersion="WebGL GLSL ES 1.0". The two webgl strings were confirmed from a live WebGL1 context (Playwright's Firefox 146) and are universal WebGL1 constants — identical on every Firefox version/OS/GPU — so they hold for FF150 too. NOTE: Playwright's bundled Firefox is NOT a valid stock reference for the automation-sensitive fields (it reports webdriver=true, webdriverType='boolean', pdfViewerEnabled=false — the OPPOSITE of stock and of Camoufox, because it is the base Camoufox patches, with automation exposed and without Camoufox's fixes). Those webdriver-hiding fields are therefore left pending here and asserted on the Camoufox side by harness.stealth_invariants(). Regenerate the full baseline against a real stock FF150 (geckodriver/BiDi, not Playwright) with: python -m tests.fingerprint_parity.harness --browser stock --executable /path/to/firefox-150/firefox --out tests/fingerprint_parity/baseline_stock_firefox_150.json
